goal: Implement the frozen first-admin /auth/invite callback and remove all currently executable browser staff sign-up and raw-link paths while preserving participant request links.

worktree.rule: Preserve the completed CCC-212 error and trust commits. No reset, rebase, switch, stash or clean. Re-read app.tsx after the trust commit and layer only the frozen callback work.

readOnly: all shared Wire components and CSS
excluded: DESIGN.md, DESIGN-RULES.md, shared UI, CSS, tokens and design artifacts
new dependency, endpoint, storage, compatibility alias, marker, query field, provider fallback or UI component
Auth setting changes, credentials, live invitation send, deployment, push or merge
implementation: Follow the frozen data types, functions, closed fragment parser, failure mapping, route state machine, first-admin separation, fail-closed staff cutover, exact paths and implementation order.
captureInviteUrlBeforeRender runs synchronously before router creation or any network and removes callback query/hash. The legacy /staff/join search/hash is scrubbed and discarded before render.

Use one existing CloudAuth client with memory-only invitation state. Never put token, subject, email, password or provider text in React state, errors, logs, URL/history, browser storage, non-Auth requests or DOM.

After updateUser confirms password success, local-scope signout is best-effort, local cleanup is mandatory, and the result is complete. provider_unavailable is retryable only when preparation or updateUser itself is unconfirmed and the unexpired invitation session remains retained.
The callback never calls a business API or claims users row, role, invite consumption, binding or business access. It tells the user to wait for installer resume, then use a later fresh login.

Delete signUpWithPassword, PublicSession.signUp, public staff lookup/accept client paths, PublicTransport bearer support for public calls, InvitesApi.create and raw /staff/join link creation. Keep staff list/revoke with a fixed not-ready callout. Keep legacy /staff/join as a zero-network fail-closed screen.
Do not change participant /join#t request-link behavior, public_signup, disclosures or completion.
uiWorkflow: Before editing, read skill://frontend-lane, skill://design-lane and DESIGN-RULES.md. This frontend-owned screen must reuse existing Wire components and CSS; no design-lane file write is needed unless a missing shared component is proven, in which case stop and hand off.
Use one PageTitle h1, existing hierarchy components, visible labels for the two password inputs, autocomplete=new-password and existing action layout. No new style class or design token.
After functional gates, obtain a separate read-only design review of the rendered callback and fail-closed legacy screen. Apply only findings within the allowed files and rerun affected gates.
verification: Use LSP references before exported symbol deletions when available and migrate every caller. If no server, record exact caller search and zero residual forbidden symbol/path occurrences.

Run targeted tests with direct selection: pnpm --filter @ccc/client exec vitest run --config vitest.config.ts src/business/auth.test.ts src/screens/invites.test.ts. Do not use the package test wrapper with a literal --.
Run pnpm --filter @ccc/client run typecheck and pnpm --filter @ccc/client run build after targeted tests.

Run the frozen actual-browser scenarios on a disposable local synthetic installation/Auth fixture, inspect URL/history/referrer/storage/console/analytics/network/React-visible state/DOM, and close all tabs and services.
Commit only allowed explicit paths locally with configured hooks. Do not bypass hooks, push, merge, deploy or contact external services.
report: Print marker, parent and commit SHA, exact paths, targeted test/typecheck/build counts, browser leak matrix, design review result, clean state and blockers.
